<style>
/* ==================================================================
   Telekom Business Mail — cookie notice stylesheet
   GTM container GTM-MX98H7G, Custom HTML tag "Cookie Popup CSS".
   ------------------------------------------------------------------
   Replaces the previous 1914-line tag, which shipped a whole
   .bootstrap-iso Bootstrap 3.3.4 build plus ~900 lines of unscoped
   utility classes. That version leaked .center, .current, .col-*,
   .white and the .pad-/.mt-/.fs- scales onto every host page — and
   .center in particular collided with style.css's
   .center{display:flex}, which broke the table layout.

   Everything here is scoped under .cookieModalPlugin. The markup and
   the JS tag are unchanged, so this file must honour their existing
   class contract exactly.

   Brand tokens (hard-coded, not var(), so the tag is self-contained):
     magenta   #E20074   hover #B5005D
     heading   #1a1a1a   body #333   muted #8a8a8a
     hairline  #ECECEC   field border #cfcfcf
     surfaces  #fff      hover grey #F0F0F0   header grey #F7F7F7
     radius    card/pill 20px · table 12px
     font      TeleNeoWeb (NB: not "TeleNeo" — that family does not exist)
   ================================================================== */

/* ---------- 1. scope root ------------------------------------------
   .cookieModalPlugin must stay static with no transform/filter/
   opacity/will-change/contain: any of those would create a containing
   block and break the position:fixed bar and modal nested inside it. */

.cookieModalPlugin,
.cookieModalPlugin button,
.cookieModalPlugin table {
	font-family: 'TeleNeoWeb', 'TeleNeo', Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
	font-size: 14px;
	line-height: 1.5;
	color: #333;
}

.cookieModalPlugin *,
.cookieModalPlugin *:before,
.cookieModalPlugin *:after {
	box-sizing: border-box;
}

/* empty anchor used only as a JS click target */
.cookieModalPlugin #cookiebtn { display: none; }

/* ---------- 2. neutralise the Bootstrap grid -----------------------
   bootstrap.min.css is loaded unscoped on 9 other pages, so .col-md-9
   etc. may be globally defined at (0,1,0). These shims are (0,2,0) and
   win without !important. All five properties Bootstrap sets must be
   reset, not just width. */

.cookieModalPlugin .row,
.cookieModalPlugin .col-xs-12,
.cookieModalPlugin .col-sm-5,
.cookieModalPlugin .col-sm-7,
.cookieModalPlugin .col-sm-12,
.cookieModalPlugin .col-md-3,
.cookieModalPlugin .col-md-4,
.cookieModalPlugin .col-md-5,
.cookieModalPlugin .col-md-7,
.cookieModalPlugin .col-md-9,
.cookieModalPlugin .col-md-12 {
	position: static;
	float: none;
	width: auto;
	max-width: none;
	min-height: 0;
	margin: 0;
	padding: 0;
}

/* ---------- 3. the utilities the markup actually uses ---------------
   Must stay ABOVE the component blocks: both are (0,2,0), so source
   order decides and components have to win. */

.cookieModalPlugin .pad-0  { padding: 0; }
.cookieModalPlugin .pad-5  { padding: 5px; }
.cookieModalPlugin .pad-30 { padding: 30px; }
.cookieModalPlugin .pt-30  { padding-top: 30px; }
.cookieModalPlugin .pr-30  { padding-right: 30px; }
.cookieModalPlugin .pb-10  { padding-bottom: 10px; }
.cookieModalPlugin .pl-0   { padding-left: 0; }
.cookieModalPlugin .mt-0   { margin-top: 0; }
.cookieModalPlugin .mt-10  { margin-top: 10px; }
.cookieModalPlugin .mb-30  { margin-bottom: 30px; }
.cookieModalPlugin .fs-12  { font-size: 12px; }

/* ---------- 4. visibility + alignment ------------------------------
   .hidden is the ONE justified !important in this file: it must
   outrank bootstrap.min.css's own .hidden{display:none!important} on
   the pages that load it, or both tab panels render at once.
   .currentSelected deliberately gets no display, so .hidden is the
   single authority on panel visibility.

   th/td .center are element-qualified (0,2,1) to restore table-cell
   against style.css:2542 .center{display:flex;justify-content:center}. */

.cookieModalPlugin .hidden { display: none !important; }

.cookieModalPlugin th.center,
.cookieModalPlugin td.center { display: table-cell; text-align: center; }

.cookieModalPlugin div.center { display: block; text-align: center; }

.cookieModalPlugin .text-center { text-align: center; }

/* ---------- 5. bottom bar ------------------------------------------
   Stays visible by default. The JS tag's accepted-cookie branch gates
   on $('.cookies__overlay'), a selector absent from this markup, so
   nothing ever shows the bar — hiding it here would mean it never
   appears at all. See REBRAND-PLAN.md "Out of scope". */

.cookieModalPlugin .cookieBottomBar {
	position: fixed;
	left: 0;
	right: 0;
	bottom: 0;
	z-index: 9999;
	display: block;
	background: #fff;
	border-radius: 20px 20px 0 0;
	box-shadow: 0 -8px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, .14);
	padding: 24px 40px;
}

.cookieModalPlugin .cookieContainer {
	max-width: 1180px;
	margin: 0 auto;
	display: flex;
	align-items: flex-start;
	gap: 28px;
}

/* min-width:0 is load-bearing — flex items default to min-width:auto
   (= max-content) and the Greek copy is one long unbroken paragraph,
   which would otherwise push the button column off-screen. */
.cookieModalPlugin .cookieLeftSide {
	flex: 1 1 auto;
	min-width: 0;
	max-height: 34vh;
	overflow-y: auto;
	padding-right: 6px;
}

.cookieModalPlugin .cookieRightSide {
	flex: 0 0 240px;
	display: flex;
	flex-direction: column;
	gap: 10px;
}

.cookieModalPlugin .cookieRightSide > div { padding: 0; }

.cookieModalPlugin .cookieMainPopuoTitle {
	margin: 0 0 8px;
	font-size: 19px;
	font-weight: 700;
	line-height: 1.3;
	color: #1a1a1a;
}

/* ---------- 6. buttons ---------------------------------------------
   style.css:2621 has an unscoped `button{...border-color:var(--tn-magenta)}`.
   Declaring only background/color leaves a magenta outset ridge, so
   `border: 0` is required, not optional. */

.cookieModalPlugin .cookieMainPopupButton,
.cookieModalPlugin .cookieCenterPopupButton {
	display: block;
	width: 100%;
	border: 0;
	border-radius: 20px;
	padding: 13px 20px;
	background: #E20074;
	color: #fff;
	font: 500 15px/1.2 'TeleNeoWeb', 'TeleNeo', Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
	text-align: center;
	cursor: pointer;
	-webkit-appearance: none;
	appearance: none;
	transition: background-color .15s;
}

.cookieModalPlugin .cookieMainPopupButton:hover,
.cookieModalPlugin .cookieMainPopupButton:focus,
.cookieModalPlugin .cookieCenterPopupButton:hover,
.cookieModalPlugin .cookieCenterPopupButton:focus {
	background: #B5005D;
	color: #fff;
}

.cookieModalPlugin .cookieCenterPopupButton {
	width: auto;
	min-width: 240px;
	padding: 10px 24px;
}

/* tertiary action — style.css:95 `a{color:#606060}` is (0,0,1), scoped
   class wins */
.cookieModalPlugin .cookieMoreInfoBtn {
	display: block;
	padding: 12px 20px;
	border: 1px solid #cfcfcf;
	border-radius: 20px;
	background: #fff;
	color: #1a1a1a;
	font: 500 15px/1.2 'TeleNeoWeb', 'TeleNeo', Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
	text-align: center;
	text-decoration: none;
	cursor: pointer;
	transition: background-color .15s;
}

.cookieModalPlugin .cookieMoreInfoBtn:hover,
.cookieModalPlugin .cookieMoreInfoBtn:focus {
	background: #F0F0F0;
	color: #1a1a1a;
}

/* the markup carries .mt-10 on this anchor, but .cookieRightSide already
   spaces its children with gap:10px — without this the two buttons sit 20px
   apart instead of 10px */
.cookieModalPlugin .cookieRightSide .cookieMoreInfoBtn { margin-top: 0; }

.cookieModalPlugin .cookieMainPopupButton:focus-visible,
.cookieModalPlugin .cookieCenterPopupButton:focus-visible,
.cookieModalPlugin .cookieMoreInfoBtn:focus-visible,
.cookieModalPlugin .modal-header .close:focus-visible {
	outline: 2px solid #1a1a1a;
	outline-offset: 2px;
}

/* ---------- 7. modal chrome ----------------------------------------
   The inlined Bootstrap modal drives visibility through INLINE styles
   ($el.show()/$el.hide() write display:block/none). So:
     - .modal gets display:none with NO !important, or JS can't win
     - `in` controls opacity ONLY, never display
     - never display:flex on .modal — jQuery overwrites it on open;
       centre the dialog with margin:auto instead
   .modal.in must follow .modal.fade: equal specificity, later wins. */

.cookieModalPlugin.modal-open { overflow: visible; }

.cookieModalPlugin .modal {
	display: none;
	position: fixed;
	top: 0;
	right: 0;
	bottom: 0;
	left: 0;
	z-index: 10000;
	overflow-x: hidden;
	overflow-y: auto;
	-webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
	outline: 0;
}

.cookieModalPlugin .modal.fade { opacity: 0; transition: opacity .15s linear; }
.cookieModalPlugin .modal.in   { opacity: 1; }

.cookieModalPlugin .modal-backdrop {
	position: fixed;
	top: 0;
	right: 0;
	bottom: 0;
	left: 0;
	z-index: 9998;
	background: #000;
}

.cookieModalPlugin .modal-backdrop.fade { opacity: 0; transition: opacity .15s linear; }
.cookieModalPlugin .modal-backdrop.in   { opacity: .5; }

/* the old tag pinned height:472px!important with no overflow, which is
   why content spilled outside the white card */
.cookieModalPlugin .cookiePackage-modal-dialog {
	position: relative;
	width: 100%;
	max-width: 720px;
	margin: 40px auto;
	padding: 0 12px;
}

.cookieModalPlugin .modal-content {
	position: relative;
	background: #fff;
	border: 0;
	border-radius: 20px;
	overflow: hidden;
	box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, .28);
}

.cookieModalPlugin .modal-header {
	display: flex;
	justify-content: flex-end;
	align-items: center;
	padding: 14px 18px 0;
	border: 0;
	min-height: 0;
}

/* intersection of three stylesheets — bootstrap .close{float:right;
   opacity:.2;text-shadow:0 1px 0 #fff} and style.css button{background:
   magenta;border-color:magenta}. Omitting any one of these declarations
   produces a visible defect. */
.cookieModalPlugin .modal-header .close {
	float: none;
	width: 32px;
	height: 32px;
	padding: 0;
	margin: 0;
	background: transparent;
	border: 0;
	border-radius: 50%;
	font: 400 26px/1 Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
	color: #E20074;
	text-shadow: none;
	opacity: 1;
	cursor: pointer;
	-webkit-appearance: none;
	appearance: none;
}

.cookieModalPlugin .modal-header .close:hover,
.cookieModalPlugin .modal-header .close:focus {
	background: #F0F0F0;
	color: #B5005D;
	opacity: 1;
}

.cookieModalPlugin .modal-body { position: relative; padding: 8px 0 16px; }

.cookieModalPlugin .modal-footer {
	display: flex;
	justify-content: center;
	padding: 14px 18px;
	background: #F7F7F7;
	border-top: 1px solid #ECECEC;
	text-align: center;
}

.cookieModalPlugin .modal-footer .col-md-4 { flex: 0 0 auto; }

/* ---------- 8. dialog interior -------------------------------------
   Child combinator is essential: both tab panels contain a
   <form class="row">, and a blanket .row{display:flex} would turn those
   into flex rows and collapse the table. */

.cookieModalPlugin .cookieOnload-modal__content__int--alert > .row {
	display: flex;
	align-items: stretch;
}

.cookieModalPlugin .cookieMainPopupLeftSide {
	flex: 0 0 40%;
	max-width: 40%;
	min-width: 0;
	padding: 16px 0 16px 12px;
}

/* min-width:0 here is what makes .table-responsive's overflow-x:auto
   actually engage — an auto-min-width flex item grows to fit the table
   instead of scrolling it. */
.cookieModalPlugin .cookieMainPopupRightSide {
	flex: 1 1 auto;
	min-width: 0;
	max-height: 320px;
	overflow-y: auto;
	padding: 16px 20px 0;
	border-left: 1px solid #ECECEC;
}

.cookieModalPlugin .cookieMainPopupRightSide::-webkit-scrollbar,
.cookieModalPlugin .cookieLeftSide::-webkit-scrollbar {
	width: 8px;
	background: #F0F0F0;
}

.cookieModalPlugin .cookieMainPopupRightSide::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb,
.cookieModalPlugin .cookieLeftSide::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
	border-radius: 4px;
	background: #cfcfcf;
}

.cookieModalPlugin .content-text { margin: 0 0 14px; }

/* ---------- 9. tab list --------------------------------------------
   style.css:110 `ul,li{margin:0;padding:0}` is (0,0,1) — scoped wins.
   The arrow was at left:100% on a width:100% li, i.e. rendered outside
   its own column; it now sits in a reserved right gutter. */

.cookieModalPlugin .tab-list { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

.cookieModalPlugin .tab-list li {
	position: relative;
	display: block;
	width: 100%;
	padding: 14px 28px 14px 8px;
	font-size: 15px;
	color: #333;
	cursor: pointer;
}

.cookieModalPlugin .tab-list li:hover { color: #E20074; }

.cookieModalPlugin .tab-list li.current { color: #E20074; font-weight: 700; }

.cookieModalPlugin .tab-list li.right-arrow:after {
	content: '';
	position: absolute;
	right: 8px;
	top: 50%;
	margin-top: -7px;
	width: 0;
	height: 0;
	border-top: 7px solid transparent;
	border-bottom: 7px solid transparent;
	border-left: 9px solid #E20074;
}

/* ---------- 10. cookie table ---------------------------------------
   .table-responsive was previously defined NOWHERE, and the old
   td/th rules hard-set min-width:100px + .moreWidth 160px = 460px of
   minimum inside a ~410px column, guaranteeing overflow with no scroll.
   .isoTable was styled only inside @media print. */

.cookieModalPlugin .table-responsive {
	width: 100%;
